apps.whats_new:
48.19.3  (November 2026)  SECURITY RULES 47 (MEETINGS AND PRAYER GROUPS)
  Online Giving → Copy Security Rules / Make Giving Page Files give rules version 47, the same as Website Update 74 (meetings
  taken on the phone, prayer groups, urgent prayer requests). Publishing the rules from here no longer takes those away.
  Nothing else changed.

apps.name: Beacon Secretary
apps.whats_new:
v4.38.6 - NO EMPTY GROUP AFTER RENAMING POINTS; ALL GROUPS CAN BE SEEN (and Website Update 89)
  - When prayer points were renamed or added since last time ("Guidance and Protection 1" → "Guidance 1"), last time's merges
    could leave a group without a point ("Group 5 has no prayer point"). Now an empty group takes a point from the group with
    the most points; the points found by name keep their group, and the urgent requests stay in the last group.
  - Prayer groups → The groups: a scroll bar, so all the groups can be seen (with 8 groups some were hidden).
  - The member portal does the same (Website Update 89).
